tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & E-Commerce Platforms
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Developer
cover_en.hook: I am very interested in contributing my expertise to your growing e-commerce initiatives. With over 5 years of professional experience building, extending, and supporting large-scale enterprise commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical proficiency in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, and robust e-commerce architectures.

bullets.label: Scalable E-Commerce Solutions
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: API Development & Headless Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and custom RESTful APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for complex data flows.

bullets.label: Platform Enhancements & Maintenance
bullets.text: Maintained and extended core commerce modules including the Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), FlexibleSearch queries, Cronjobs, Impex scripts, and Backoffice components.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integration & Performance
bullets.text: Engineered high-performance data pipelines using Hotfolders, DataHub, and Profisee, and led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am currently serving my notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 (earliest start date 16 December 2026). I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background aligns with your needs.

tailoring.why_company: I want to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce engineering experience to help build and enhance scalable digital platforms. My background in developing robust Java-based commerce solutions, REST APIs, and high-performance integrations makes me eager to contribute effectively to your technical team.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce platform engineering, Java/Spring expertise, and robust integration experience to scale and enhance digital commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I saw your opening for commerce developers. With 5+ years building enterprise e-commerce platforms (Java, Spring, REST APIs, microservices) at Rockwell and Shell, I'd love to bring my expertise to your team. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Developer role. With over 5 years of professional experience building and enhancing enterprise e-commerce platforms using Java, Spring, and RESTful APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in scalable platform development and integrations.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and can start from 16.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
